name: Fish Head Sandwich
source:
A short story about a boy who really loves sweets, but his Mother doesn't share his love for such.

Fish Head Sandwich includes a Memo. Game that is unlocked once the story is read. Then if you are quick and witty enough to beat the game, there is also a bonus "behind the scenes" video.

[From [url=http://figment68.blogspot.com/p/fish-head-sandwich.html]official site[/url]]
translation:
一个关于一个男孩非常喜欢甜食的短篇故事，但他的母亲并不分享他对甜食的热爱。

鱼头三明治包含一份备忘录。阅读故事后即可解锁的游戏。然后，如果你足够敏捷和机智来击败游戏，还有一个额外的“幕后花絮”视频。

[来自[url=http://figment68.blogspot.com/p/fish-head-sandwich.html]官方网站[/url]]
